enrichment.headline: Awards Redgwick Construction $203,900 for new playmatting and play structure at Sherman Elementary
enrichment.summary: The district awards Redgwick Construction Company of Oakland the lowest responsive bid to replace the playmatting and play structure at Sherman Elementary School. The $203,900 price includes a $9,700 contingency. Work is scheduled for 60 calendar days starting September 16, 2020 and ending November 15, 2020.
